args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions; `list_deployments` showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — INC-0001 created for checkout-api, describing the failure and the rollback (on-call paged).
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The `rollback` tool initially returned transient 503 errors (retried 3 times), so I used `deploy` to push the known-healthy v2.3.0 to all production regions instead, which succeeded.

**Verification:** checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Note:** The incident INC-0001 remains open — you may want to close it after confirming no further issues, and the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression should be investigated before any redeploy.
